headline: Any app can make a shared album. This is the part after.

find.title: Your events, on a calendar.
find.body: Every event you've been to or are going to sits on a calendar. Tap the date and the album is there. No scrolling back through a chat for the link someone posted in March.

keep.title: Download the good ones, not all 400.
keep.body: Everglow groups photos taken from the same angle and pulls the blurry misses out of the pile. You pick from what is left and download only those.
keep.imageAlt: Selecting frames in the Everglow app

share.title: Post it as an Instagram story.
share.body: Turn the album into a story. It comes out as a contact sheet, a look people will start to recognize, without a logo stamped on your post.

story.title: Saturday night, as told by nine people.
